# General Requirements Quality Checklist: System Status Page

**Purpose**: Broad completeness/clarity/consistency review of spec.md's requirements before/alongside `/speckit-tasks` — a "unit test suite for the requirements text," not a test of the (not-yet-built) implementation.
**Created**: 2026-09-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are requirements defined for what happens if the status endpoint is called before the application has finished starting up, beyond the edge-case note about the request failing to connect? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK002 Is a requirement defined for what "version" should display before a first real release exists (e.g., during initial development)? [Gap]
-  CHK003 Are requirements defined for how staff are expected to discover or reach the status page URL in the first place? [Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x]CHK004 Is the "bounded wait" duration for the data store reachability check specified as a concrete value in the requirements themselves, or only implied by a success criterion? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x]CHK005 Is "a screen narrower than a typical desktop" in User Story 3 quantified with a specific breakpoint, or left to implementation judgment? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 3]
- [x]CHK006 Is "normal network conditions" in SC-001 and SC-002 defined with any measurable baseline, or left ambiguous? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-001, §SC-002]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x]CHK007 Do FR-006's "bounded wait" and SC-004's "3 seconds" clearly describe the same threshold, or could they be read as two independently-tunable values? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §SC-004]
- [x]CHK008 Are the "OK"/"Degraded" status terms used consistently across User Stories, Edge Cases, and Functional Requirements without an implied third state creeping in anywhere? [Consistency]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x]CHK009 Can SC-002 ("no stale OK is ever shown once a fresh check has run") be objectively verified from requirements text alone, without assuming a particular caching implementation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x]CHK010 Is SC-003 ("100% of load attempts... return a response") paired with any defined maximum acceptable response time, or is it only a boolean pass/fail criterion? [Acceptance Criteria Quality, Spec §SC-003]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x]CHK011 Are requirements defined for a scenario where the data store is reachable but responds with unexpected/invalid data, rather than simply timing out or refusing the connection? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x]CHK012 Are recovery-path requirements (data store becomes reachable again) stated at the functional-requirement level (FR-005/FR-006), not only inside User Story 2's acceptance scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2, §FR-005]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x]CHK013 Is there a requirement covering concurrent status page requests arriving while the data store's reachability is transitioning (e.g., going down mid-check)? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [x]CHK014 Does the spec distinguish "data store process is down" from "application has no network route to the data store" as requirements, or are both collapsed into one undifferentiated "Degraded" without saying whether that's intentional? [Edge Case, Ambiguity]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x]CHK015 Are any logging/observability expectations for this feature stated in the requirements themselves (spec.md), or do they only appear later in the implementation plan? [Traceability, Gap]
- [x]CHK016 Are accessibility requirements (e.g., how status is conveyed to assistive technology) stated for the status page, or explicitly marked out of scope? [Coverage, Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x]CHK017 Is the Assumptions-section claim that "no other external dependencies... are checked" reconciled against the project constitution's broader observability requirements, so a reviewer can confirm there's no conflict? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x]CHK018 Is "core data store" defined precisely enough in the requirements to rule out being misread as any datastore the application might later use, rather than specifically its primary relational database? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x]CHK019 Is a requirement & acceptance-criteria ID scheme consistently applied (FR-/SC- prefixes) such that every requirement is individually referenceable? [Traceability]
- [x]CHK020 Does any requirement implicitly depend on this feature continuing to exist, in a way that would conflict with the Assumptions-section note that it "may be removed or superseded" once Identity & Access ships? [Conflict, Gap]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify` — this file is independent of it
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
